title: [RPG Review] The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II

blocks.translation: [RPG Review] The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Length / Story

blocks.source: ほぼ全てのクエストを終わらせて５７時間でクリア。閃の軌跡１が７０時間だったので、合わせて約１３０時間。プレイスタイル次第ではもっと増えそう。完全に続編なので、前作プレイは必須。
blocks.translation: I cleared the game in 57 hours after completing almost every quest. Trails of Cold Steel I took 70 hours, so together they took about 130 hours. Depending on your play style, it could take even longer. Since this is a direct sequel, playing the previous game is essential.

blocks.source: 前作終了後、離れ離れになってしまった学院生達が徐々につどってゆくのは嬉しい。
blocks.translation: It is satisfying to see the students who were separated after the previous game gradually come back together.

blocks.source: ただその度にお使いイベントがあるので作業感も。前作と同じ場所を行ったり来たりするので、新鮮味が薄れるのも仕方ないところ。
blocks.translation: However, there is a fetch quest every time, which makes it feel like a chore. You also go back and forth between the same places as in the previous game, so it is understandable that it feels less fresh.

blocks.source: それなりに面白いのだけど、さすがに合わせて１００時間も超えるとマンネリ感が拭えなくなってくる。
blocks.translation: It is reasonably entertaining, but once the combined playtime exceeds 100 hours, it inevitably starts to feel repetitive.

blocks.source: それがもっとも顕著に現れるのは……
blocks.translation: This is most apparent in……

blocks.source: １．ボス戦に勝利
blocks.translation: 1. Defeat the boss

blocks.source: ２．ボス「なかなかやるな。そろそろ本気出す！」
blocks.translation: 2. Boss: “Not bad. I guess it’s time to get serious!"

blocks.source: ３．味方「ぐわっ、このままではやられる！」
blocks.translation: 3. Ally: “Gah, we’re going to lose at this rate!"

blocks.source: ４．助っ人が登場「ここは俺に任せろ！」
blocks.translation: 4. An ally appears: “Leave this to me!"

blocks.source: みたいな展開。これを何度も繰り返す。お陰でゲームシステム上の戦闘が茶番じみてしまうのは難点。元より、こういう展開の多いシリーズであることは承知だけど、今回は「またかよ！」と笑えるレベルに達している。
blocks.translation: That sort of sequence. It is repeated over and over. The downside is that this makes the battles in the actual game feel like a farce. I knew from the start that this series featured a lot of sequences like this, but this time it reaches the point where you can only laugh and say, “Again?!”

blocks.source: 終章で本編はクリアとなるけれど、その後に外伝と後日談がある。
blocks.translation: The main story is cleared in the final chapter, but there is also a side story and an epilogue afterward.

blocks.source: 外伝は零の軌跡＆碧の軌跡プレイヤー向けのファンサービス。
blocks.translation: The side story is fan service for players of Trails from Zero and Trails to Azure.

blocks.source: 後日談のほうが一応のラストダンジョンのようだが、ストーリー的にはおまけ的で意味が薄め。後日談ラスボスの戦闘前セリフがまさしくそれを表現しているけれど、個人的には結構な迷言だと思う。
blocks.translation: The epilogue is ostensibly the final dungeon, but it feels more like an extra and has little significance from a story perspective. The epilogue’s final boss says something before the battle that perfectly captures this, though personally, I think it is quite a perplexing line.

blocks.source: 閃の軌跡１からの因縁には一応の決着はついた。……が、主人公リィンの物語として見ると大きな消化不良を残したまま。空の軌跡と零＆碧の軌跡は二作で完結していたけれど、こちらはそうではない模様。
blocks.translation: The grudges originating in Trails of Cold Steel I have reached a resolution of sorts. …However, viewed as protagonist Rean’s story, it still leaves a great deal unresolved. Trails in the Sky and Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure were completed in two games each, but that does not seem to be the case here.

blocks.source: そこはまあ３に期待ということで。
blocks.translation: Well, I suppose we can look forward to III.

blocks.source: 伏線は畳むのではなく、ばらまき続けるのがこのシリーズの特徴。シリーズ第一作は2004/6/24発売だったそうで。いつまで続けるつもりなんだろう。１０～２０年も経ったら、いい加減ゲーム自体を卒業しちゃうプレイヤーも出てしまうんじゃないかなと、勝手に心配してみたり。
blocks.translation: Rather than tying up its foreshadowing, this series is characterized by continuing to scatter more of it. Apparently, the first game in the series was released on 2004/6/24. I wonder how long they intend to keep it going. I can’t help but wonder, though perhaps needlessly, whether after 10 or 20 years some players might finally outgrow games altogether.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 基本的なゲーム性は前作と同じで、今回は＋αといったところ。
blocks.translation: The basic gameplay is the same as in the previous game, with this installment adding a little extra.

blocks.source: 最も大きな追加点は仲間の数が大幅増大したこと。実に二十人弱のキャラクターを使用できるので豪華。使用期間の限られたキャラクターがいるのは残念だけれど。
blocks.translation: The biggest addition is the greatly increased number of allies. It is lavish to have just under 20 characters available to use. It is a shame that some characters can only be used for limited periods, though.

blocks.source: 前作以上に味方側の強化が著しい。連続行動ができる『オーバーライズ』が戦闘システムに搭載。技の性能向上もあって、さらに一方的に敵をボコれるように。普通にやっていてもボス敵をノーダメージ撃破できることまであった。
blocks.translation: The allies are even more powerful than in the previous game. “Overdrive,” which allows consecutive actions, has been added to the battle system. Combined with improved skill performance, this makes it possible to pummel enemies even more one-sidedly. There were even times when I defeated boss enemies without taking damage despite playing normally.

blocks.source: ただし、それへ対抗するためか敵側も強化されている。状態異常による初見殺しのハメとか、ＨＰを大回復する技を連発とか、なかなか嫌らしい手強さ。特に仲間が揃わない序盤のボスは苦戦した。
blocks.translation: The enemies have also been strengthened, presumably to counter this. They can pull nasty tricks such as trapping you with status ailments that can kill players who have not seen them before, or repeatedly using skills that massively restore their HP. The bosses early in the game were especially difficult, before I had gathered all my allies.

blocks.source: 上手なプレイヤーにとってはヌルいが、プレイスタイル次第では物凄く苦戦する可能性も。
blocks.translation: It is easy for skilled players, but depending on your play style, you may also struggle immensely.

blocks.source: 手応えが欲しい人は難易度を上げることもできるが、元々にかなりクセがあるので解決にならないかも。一方的にやられるか、一方的に勝つかのさらなる極端になりそうなので。
blocks.translation: Players looking for a challenge can raise the difficulty, but the game is already quite eccentric, so that may not solve the problem. It would likely become even more extreme, with you either getting beaten one-sidedly or winning one-sidedly.

blocks.source: 前作の終盤で見せたロボゲー要素（騎神戦）が正式に入ってきた。
blocks.translation: The mecha-game element (Divine Knight battles) introduced toward the end of the previous game has now been formally incorporated.

blocks.source: このゲームは「多彩なキャラクターが華やかに戦うキャラゲー的なもの」だと認識していたので若干の違和感も。ＦＦかと思ったらゼノギアスだったみたいな。
blocks.translation: I had understood this game to be “a character-focused game where a diverse cast fights in glamorous fashion,” so this felt somewhat jarring. It was like expecting Final Fantasy and getting Xenogears instead.

blocks.source: もっとも、空の軌跡の頃からティータなりレンなり、機械を使うキャラはいたので兆候はあったけれど。
blocks.translation: That said, there had been signs of this since Trails in the Sky, with characters like Tita and Ren who use machines.

blocks.source: イベントの締めくくりには、お約束の如く騎神が呼び出される。騎神戦は基本が一対一の地味な削り合いなので、かったるく感じることも。
blocks.translation: As if on cue, a Divine Knight is summoned to conclude events. Divine Knight battles are basically mundane one-on-one battles of attrition, so they can sometimes feel tedious.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: マップなどの多くは前作からの流用になっている。
blocks.translation: Many of the maps and other elements have been reused from the previous game.

blocks.source: 前作のキャラクターの大半は衣替えしており、若干のイメチェン。
blocks.translation: Most of the characters from the previous game have new outfits, giving them a slight makeover.

blocks.source: 仲間の数が増えたことによって技も多彩に。ただし、前作からいたキャラの技は大差ないので、そこはちょっと見飽きるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: The increased number of allies also makes the skills more varied. However, the skills of characters who were already in the previous game are not much different, so you may get a little tired of seeing them.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 基本的に前作からの使い回しながら、時々新曲あり。新曲では本編・後日談ともにラスダンやラスボスの曲が優れている。
blocks.translation: The music is mostly reused from the previous game, with new tracks appearing occasionally. Among the new tracks, the themes for the final dungeons and final bosses in both the main story and epilogue are excellent.

blocks.source: 気になったところではストーリー自体が『熱い展開』の乱発なので、音楽にもメリハリが薄く感じられる点。
blocks.translation: One thing that stood out to me was that, since the story itself repeatedly relies on “heated developments,” the music also feels lacking in variation.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 前作が面白かったので、その勢いでプレイした。
blocks.translation: I played it on the momentum of the previous game, which I had enjoyed.

blocks.source: ただ前作からの発売期間の短さ（わずか一年）もあってか、ストーリー的には息切れ感も。
blocks.translation: However, perhaps because it was released only a short time after the previous game (just one year), the story also feels somewhat short of breath.

blocks.source: 閃の軌跡３の発売が、最近になって正式発表されたようなので期待。
blocks.translation: The release of Trails of Cold Steel III seems to have been officially announced recently, so I am looking forward to it.
